principle: Never describe a scaffold or UI-only control as a finished capability.

features.name: Android native keyboard input
features.notes: InputMethodService commits text through InputConnection; real device QA is pending.

features.name: iOS Custom Keyboard Extension
features.notes: UIInputViewController source and XcodeGen project definition; Xcode build and device signing are pending.

features.name: Arabic and English layouts
features.notes: Basic letter rows and language switch; full language layouts, punctuation, dead keys and RTL QA remain.

features.name: YORY Studio
features.notes: Local preset, color, opacity and geometry controls; live IME reload behavior requires device verification and further controls.

features.name: Tinted glass rendering
features.notes: Translucent panel and key surfaces; platform-specific background blur/refraction is not yet implemented.

features.name: Offline word completion
features.notes: Starter local word lists and prefix matching on both platforms; not neural prediction or autocorrect.

features.name: Emoji picker
features.notes: Starter emoji row; searchable categories and skin-tone support are not implemented.

features.name: Alternative emoji artwork
features.notes: Artwork licenses and recipient-app rendering constraints must be respected.

features.name: Clipboard history manager
features.notes: Optional, local-only Android text clipboard history with a 50-item cap and basic sensitive-code filtering. iOS automatic clipboard history is not implemented because the platform model differs.

features.name: Screenshot/image import
features.notes: User-initiated image selection only where supported; no promise of background screenshot harvesting.

features.name: Custom sound packs
features.notes: Standard Android click effect and iOS system keyboard click are wired. User-imported/custom sound packs and per-key sound overrides are not implemented.

features.name: Keyboard haptics
features.notes: Android keyboard tap haptics and iOS light impact feedback are wired to settings; real-device behavior and user/system setting interactions remain unverified.

features.name: 120-language target catalogue
features.notes: Catalogue only. Language packs and quality certification are not shipped.

features.name: Encrypted dictionary backup
features.notes: No user words are uploaded in plaintext; client-side encryption implementation is still required.

features.name: Standard key sound and light haptics
features.notes: Uses platform-standard click/haptic APIs and local user preferences; physical-device QA is pending.
